summary: Iteration 141 - Mobility Checkout & Tracking Testing Complete. All backend APIs (15/15 tests PASS) including Stripe checkout session creation, preferences persistence, booking tracking, and cancel functionality. Frontend shows all checkout methods (Wallet/NFC/QR/Apple Pay/Google Pay), AI preferences panel, QR checkout card with Stripe link, and new tracking page with full booking details.
